message.factorycraft.placement_space: Need a loaded, unobstructed 2x2x2 area to the right, above and behind the front block.
command.factorycraft.smelter_space: Need a loaded empty 6 x 5 x 7 area beside you.
tooltip.factorycraft.multiblock_controls: Places the complete machine. Sneak + wrench dismantles it.
message.factorycraft.assembly_missing: Structure unavailable. Check that all its chunks are loaded and parts are intact.
message.factorycraft.dismantle: Sneak + wrench dismantles the machine safely; contents are not destroyed.
command.factorycraft.smelter: Multiblock smelter built at %s. Its source chest contains 12 raw iron.
tooltip.factorycraft.industrial_furnace: One item places a 2x2x2 machine. Twice the furnace speed; same FE per result.
tooltip.factorycraft.machine_casing: Part of a multiblock. Shares the controller inventory and power; stores no items.
tooltip.factorycraft.belt: Two lanes. Items follow the arrow; stopped output causes a jam.
tooltip.factorycraft.splitter: Alternates between the forward and right outputs.
tooltip.factorycraft.inserter: Picks up behind, delivers ahead. Mechanical; one item per cycle.
tooltip.factorycraft.electric_drill: Mines finite ore in a 3x3 area, up to 8 blocks below. Requires power.
tooltip.factorycraft.electric_furnace: Smelts raw iron/copper into plates. Requires power.
tooltip.factorycraft.assembling_machine: Assembles counted ingredients. Open to inspect/select a recipe.
tooltip.factorycraft.coal_generator: Fuel goes in the bottom slot. Supplies machines through poles.
tooltip.factorycraft.electric_pole: Connects nearby poles and powers machines inside coverage.
tooltip.factorycraft.rotate: Right-click with a factory wrench to rotate.
command.factorycraft.space: Need a loaded empty 16 x 5 x 8 area beside you.
command.factorycraft.demo: Automatic iron factory built at %s. Nine finite ores will produce four gears.
message.factorycraft.direction: Output: %s. Use a wrench to rotate.
tooltip.factorycraft.fluid_pipe: 1000 mB. Up to 100 mB/t per connection; liquids equalize locally.
tooltip.factorycraft.fluid_tank: 16000 mB. Holds one fluid; retains contents when harvested.
tooltip.factorycraft.electric_pump: Water source or fluid input behind; output ahead. 100 mB/t, 20 FE per active tick.
command.factorycraft.fluid_space: Need a loaded empty 9 x 4 x 5 area beside you.
